fields.h1: Build a Rental Agreement Form Tenants Fill and Sign Online
fields.hero_description: Describe the property and your terms. Emergent builds the rental agreement form, sends each finished agreement out for signature and keeps every lease in a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What a Rental Agreement Form Should Cover
fields.features_subheading: Every agreement rests on the same core terms. These six features take each lease from those terms to a signed copy.
fields.feature_1:
Every term in its own field

Emergent asks for the parties, the address, the lease term, the rent with its due date and grace period, the late fee, the deposit, utilities, pets and who handles repairs.
fields.feature_2:
Follow-up questions where they apply

A tenant who says they have a dog is asked its breed and weight. One who parks on site gives a plate number for the permit. Everyone else never sees those two questions.
fields.feature_3:
A filled agreement ready to sign

Submitting the form fills every blank in the agreement and turns it into a PDF. Each party signs on screen with a finger or a mouse, and the clauses lock after the first signature.
fields.feature_4:
The right disclosures on each lease

Record when each property was built, and units from before 1978 get the lead paint disclosure and EPA pamphlet in their packet. Attach state or city addenda by property too.
fields.feature_5:
One table for every lease you manage

Each signed agreement becomes a row with its unit, tenants, rent and end date. Filter the table by property, or search a tenant's name when a question about their unit comes in.
fields.feature_6:
Your domain, your source code

Publish the form on your own domain or link it from a rental listing. Export the full source to GitHub whenever a developer wants to add a tenant portal or online rent collection.

fields.usecase_heading: Rental Agreement Forms for Every Property
fields.tab_content_1:
House rules the tenant signs before move-in

One link goes to the new tenant of a spare room. They enter a move-in date and an emergency contact, then read the house rules: quiet after 10 pm, overnight guests for 3 nights at most. Rent is $950, due on the 1st. The agreement goes out for signature the moment they submit.
fields.tab_content_2:
Leases ending within 60 days surface first

Every lease at Birch Court sits in one table, sorted by end date. Anything ending within 60 days rises to the top, and the property manager gets an email to start the renewal conversation. All 48 units stay in one view instead of a folder of PDFs.
fields.tab_content_3:
Nothing is final until the last roommate signs

Each roommate on the lease gets a personal signing link and sees their share: $800 of the $2,400 rent. The landlord can see who has signed. Anyone still unsigned after two days gets a reminder, and the finished copy reaches all three once the last signature is in.
fields.tab_content_4:
Collect the damage deposit with the booking

Guests booking the lake house accept the stay rules on the same form they book with: check-in at 4 pm, checkout by 11 am, six guests at most. A $300 damage deposit is collected through Stripe, and the stay is confirmed only after the guest signs.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Rental Agreement Form
fields.howto_description: Settle the terms before you write a single field.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 List the terms that never change
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Decide what the tenant fills in
fields.howto_step_1_des: Write down what stays the same for every tenant at this property, from the rent figure to who fixes a leaking tap. These become fixed text in the agreement, and no tenant can edit them when they fill in the form.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Ask only for what changes from one tenant to the next. Names of the adults on the lease and the move-in date are the core. Keep income and background questions for a separate screening step.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Deposit caps and return deadlines vary by state, and so do the disclosures a lease must carry. California, for example, caps most deposits at one month's rent and gives landlords 21 days after move-out to return them.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Describe the property and paste your terms into the prompt word for word. The fixed clauses then read exactly as you wrote them. Change any wording later by asking in plain English, and the update goes live on the same link.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Choose who signs and in what order. For example, put each tenant first and the landlord last. Add a guarantor as a separate signer for any tenant you approved on that condition.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Decide who hears about new leases
fields.howto_step_6_des: Once an agreement is fully signed, pick the people who need to act on it, such as whoever hands over keys and the bookkeeper who sets up rent. Send each of them an email or Slack message with a direct link to the record.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Test it with a made-up tenant
fields.howto_step_7_des: Fill the form as a fictional tenant, sign as both parties and read the PDF line by line. Then have a local attorney review the agreement text before the first real tenant signs it. Fix anything they flag by prompting, and test once more.

scope.evidence: H1 'Build a Rental Agreement Form Tenants Fill and Sign Online', meta title 'Free Rental Agreement Form Builder', hero covers form, signature and lease records.

intent.evidence: Template and government-PDF SERP answered with the terms an agreement needs (feature_1), state rules (howto_step_3), where to get free forms (FAQ 4, FAQ 5) and all nine PAA questions.

specificity.evidence: 'quiet after 10 pm, overnight guests for 3 nights at most', 'All 48 units', '$800 of the $2,400 rent', 'A $300 damage deposit is collected through Stripe', 'units from before 1978 get the lead paint disclosure and EPA pamphlet'.

openers.evidence: Every body opens on a full sentence: 'Emergent asks for the parties...', 'A tenant who says they have a dog...', 'One link goes to the new tenant of a spare room.'

craft.evidence: CONTENT_DEFECTS #21, introduced by the cycle-3 rewrite: 'fixed clause or tenant field' is said in features_subheading 'Emergent turns each one into a field the tenant fills in or a clause they cannot change.', howto_description 'The seven steps below decide what stays fixed in the lease and what each tenant fills in.' and howto_step_1_des 'These become fixed text in the agreement, and no tenant can edit them when they fill in the form.'

voice.evidence: Plain, specific lines: 'One who parks on site gives a plate number for the permit.', 'Anyone still unsigned after two days gets a reminder'.

truth.evidence: California deposit cap and 21 days (Civ. 1950.5), lease over one year in writing (Civ. 1624), handwriting as writing (Evid. 250), pre-1978 lead disclosure (EPA), Oklahoma four-page PDF all match domain_sources; e-signature-capture is used with no legal-validity claim; $800 x 3 = $2,400.

distinct.evidence: Room, multi-unit, shared lease and vacation stays are its own; lease-renewal-form and tenant-screening-form are linked, not imitated; no sibling primary in a heading.

faq.evidence: Cycle-2 blocking fixed: FAQ 5 opens 'Government sites post them free: the Oklahoma Department of Commerce...'; FAQ 6 opens 'In California, yes'. All ten answer in the first sentence; FAQ 9 now answers with the free tier, not the lease table.

images.evidence: Tab 1 $950 due the 1st, quiet after 10 pm, 3 nights; tab 2 Birch Court 48 units, 4B ends in 38 days, 2A 54 days, renewal email; tab 3 $800 shares of $2,400, Riley Nash unsigned 2 days, reminded; tab 4 4 pm, 11 am, 6 guests, $300 via Stripe, stay confirmed after signing.
